headword: {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}

definitions.explanation: A type of fat found in the blood and body tissues, commonly measured in blood tests. High levels are considered a risk factor for cardiovascular disease.

examples.japanese: {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}の{値|あたい}が{高|たか}い。
{運動|うんどう}をして{中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす。
{健康診断|けんこうしんだん}で{中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}の{数値|すうち}が{基準|きじゅん}を{超|こ}えていると{言|い}われた。
examples.english: At my health checkup, I was told my triglyceride level exceeded the normal range.

notes:
Composed of {中性|ちゅうせい} (neutral, in a chemical sense) and {脂肪|しぼう} (fat). The name reflects that these lipids are chemically neutral, as opposed to fatty acids, which are acidic. {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう} is one of the standard values checked in a Japanese {健康診断|けんこうしんだん} (health checkup), and the term appears frequently in discussions of diet, exercise, and lifestyle-related diseases. The English medical term is "triglycerides."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}が{高|たか}い: triglyceride level is high
- {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}を{減|へ}らす: to reduce triglycerides
- {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}の{値|あたい}/{数値|すうち}: triglyceride level/reading
- {中性脂肪|ちゅうせいしぼう}が{基準値|きじゅんち}を{超|こ}える: triglycerides exceed the standard value

RELATED TERMS:
- コレステロール: cholesterol — another type of lipid measured in blood tests
- {脂質|ししつ}: lipids, fats (as a general category)
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう}: subcutaneous fat
- {内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}: visceral fat
- {血糖値|けっとうち}: blood sugar level — another common blood test value
